title: Liquid storage meters and draining digits
blurb: Semantic HTML <meter> storage bars and bold <output> quota numerals drawn as sloshing coloured fluid vessels inside one WebGL 2 canvas while keeping every control live.
question: Can semantic HTML <meter> storage bars and large live <output> quota numerals serve directly as fluid-filled glass vessels in a single WebGL 2 fragment shader so sloshing coloured liquids fill, layer, meniscus-ripple, and drain in real time when cache is cleared or quota sliders move while keeping every native control live?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. One ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas uploads a live dashboard holding four semantic <meter> bars, an <input type="range"> slider, action buttons and a bold <output> quota readout via texElementSubImage2D(), turning DOM luminance silhouettes into layered sloshing vessels and hollow fluid numerals while preserving hit testing via updateElementGeometry() scaled by geometryUnit().
